content.json:
# Coverage and Gaps

This view distinguishes required MVP sources from optional or preview coverage. Native services remain authoritative even when their telemetry is unavailable in Sentinel. Optional custom interaction and usage integrations are not part of the default MVP.

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| extend CoverageClass=iff(RequiredForMvp, "MVP", "Optional or conditional")
| summarize Sources=count(), Healthy=countif(Status == "Healthy"), Gaps=countif(Status != "Healthy") by CoverageClass
content.title: MVP and optional coverage

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| where Status != "Healthy"
| extend CoverageClass=iff(RequiredForMvp, "MVP", "Optional or conditional")
| project CoverageClass, TableName, Status, LastEventTime, ExpectedFreshness, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute
| order by CoverageClass asc, TableName asc
content.title: Documented gaps and native owners
